release.title: Correct MCP access guidance and show working setup for each client
release.default_user_change: The website explains that free MCP tools work without an API key and shows a working setup for each advertised client.

artifact.build_rule: Build once from the pinned source, apply the protected web overlays, verify those exact bytes, then deploy with no additional build.

protection.private_record_rule: The canary record remains outside the repository. Its exact hash is bound here, and verification fails if it is absent or changed.

netlify_cli.enforcement: The version and both file hashes must match before the one-use receipt is created.

netlify.rollback_deploy_title: Preserve MCP preview results on the Supericons web grid
netlify.preflight_rule: Stop before reservation or deployment if the current published deploy is not the pinned rollback deploy.
netlify.visibility_rule: After deployment, check the published deploy for up to 60 seconds before treating visibility as failed.

probe_inventory.evidence: Two builds must have the same file count, byte count, and tree hash.
An explicit icon list survives delayed popularity, locale, and authentication events.
A query preview survives delayed popularity, locale, and authentication events.
Unknown explicit references show zero results and never expose the full grid.
A late hosted result cannot restore preview mode after Browse all icons.
The view=icons parameter remains in the preview URL and after deliberate preview exit.
The final web bytes exclude all five protected intelligence classes.
The final web bytes include license evidence and the privately bound canaries.
A changed production baseline makes zero deploy and restore calls.
The same manifest cannot make a second external call after reservation.
Any failed live verification restores only the pinned production deploy.
A failed site read after deployment still makes one exact restore call and verifies the restored state.
A temporarily old published-deploy response is retried and succeeds without a restore when the intended deploy becomes visible within the bounded wait.
A failed restore leaves a terminal local record and cannot be replayed.
The Netlify CLI version, entry point, and package record match the manifest before reservation.

Every advertised client selects its own valid setup and exact file location. The OpenCode assertion requires Project: opencode.json or opencode.jsonc. Global: ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc.
Copy copies the currently selected client setup exactly.
Arrow, Home, and End keys move selection through the client tabs.
All client tabs remain reachable on a narrow screen.
The English API key page states that free local and hosted MCP tools need no key.
The browser check verifies the German keyless MCP statement as a localized spot check.
The release runner invokes the existing localization consistency check, and the packet verifier requires its successful result.

postdeploy_checks.client_tabs: All seven client tabs select a valid setup, show the correct file location, and copy the active text.
postdeploy_checks.keyboard_and_mobile: Keyboard navigation and narrow-screen tab access work.
postdeploy_checks.api_key_docs: The browser check verifies today's English guidance and a German localized spot check. Human review owns the meaning of the wording across all 12 maintained locales.
postdeploy_checks.preview_regression: Explicit and query preview links keep their results, unknown references stay empty, and late hosted responses stay invalidated.
postdeploy_checks.protection: The public license, provenance, canaries, and protected-class boundary match the staged artifact.

rollback.trigger: Any deploy response mismatch, site-read failure or visibility timeout after the bounded checks, current-site mismatch, live behavior failure, or protection failure after the deployment starts.
rollback.action: After any deployment attempt, restore Netlify deploy 6a5a62e4382d02608226d0f7 once without requiring a pre-restore site read, verify it is current, record the failure, and stop.
rollback.replay: Any in-progress, successful, rolled-back, or rollback-failed receipt blocks another execution. Reconciliation requires a new independently reviewed manifest.

excluded_actions: No npm publication or tag change.
No Supabase function, schema, data, or configuration change.
No production load test or hosted search comparison.
